# Engineering fixtures only

These files test schemas, timings, ownership transfers, ability restrictions, review hashes, migration and export. Creative prose from the retired plans has been erased and replaced with opaque fixture identifiers; structural layouts are retained only where regressions depend on them.

- timing-30: multi-shot timeline, ability limits, review dependencies.
- single-take: continuous camera, compact projection binding.
- action-transfer: event order, hand ownership and item transfer.
- ability-restrictions: ability lifecycle and subsequent hand restrictions.
- three-actors: complete participant and state coverage.
- camera-facts: camera fact/expression invalidation.
- legacy-v1: schema migration without implicit review.
- limit-15: synthetic platform capability conflict.

Synthetic attestations are deliberately not semantic or media reviews. Do not use these files as creative examples or quality evidence. They are excluded from the skill and its archives. Test exports are temporary; no generated prompt snapshots are stored.
